subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI request be scoped to documenting current pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: Current main already gets partial multiline composition from pi-tui, but the remaining configurable behavior would create a public keybinding/config surface and possibly CLI/docs contract that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Document Current Behavior First
options.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable bindings.

options.title: Approve A TUI Keybinding Bridge
options.body: Expose a supported TUI send/newline preference through a config or CLI bridge, with focused tests and compatibility-aware docs.

options.title: Close As Sufficient
options.body: Treat dependency-level newline support as enough and explicitly decline docs/help/config follow-up for this issue.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback while deferring configurable bindings.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter originated and most recently maintained the TUI/docs path and already participated in this issue's product-scope review.
